To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the HCV NS 3 antigen assay is a useful diagnostic tool for the early detection of HCV infection and that the HCV antigen test is more sensitive than the anti-HCV assay in early stage of HCV infection.
(1) The HCV NS 3 antigen detection assay is a useful method for earlier diagnosis of hepatitis C virus infection.

(1) the HCV NS 3 antigen detection assay has perfect specificity, and higher sensitivity than HCV-RNA detection assay; (2) the HCV antigen detection assay can be used in routine laboratories test for the earlier diagnosis of HVC infection; and (3) the HCV antigens in sera of HCV infected patients can be detected by ELISA, and there is a negative correlation between their A values of NS3 antigen and duration of test.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new methods for the determination of HCV NS 3 antigen in human serum.
the development of an efficient and simple technique for the detection of hepatitis C virus (HCV) in blood samples.
the development of a new method of diagnosis of hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of a HCV NS3 Ag assay is not recommended for screening purposes, but may have a role as a supplementary assay for the detection of acute HCV infections, and as a marker of viral replication in chronic hepatitis C patients.
the NS3 antigen detection is a good diagnostic test for hepatitis C virus.
there is no conclusive data to show that there is any benefit of using HCV RNA testing in place of HCV antibody testing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully developed a new HCV NS3 Ag detection assay and have evaluated its clinical application in China.
we have successfully established the HCV NS 3 antigen detection ELISA kit and applied to clinical diagnosis.
we have developed a simple and sensitive assay to detect HCV infection and the assay has a great potential in clinical application.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the HCV NS 3 antigen detection assay has a perfect specificity and higher sensitivitv,and it will be useful in developing countries for earlier diagnosis of hepatitis C infection.
